subject: Next steps & eval kickoff - Finlytics trial plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:06:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposal: evaluation kickoff

Hi Aisha -

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Finlytics wants to evaluate Redwood for two primary use cases - (1) summarization + question-answering over customer support tickets, and (2) a reranking flow to prioritize alerts for the ops team. Your goals are to validate latency/throughput at our expected load, and confirm output quality against your prompt set.

Next steps I suggest:
- Schedule a 60-min evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan) with our Solutions Engineer (Marissa).
- Share a short trial plan (scope, success criteria, timeline) and a small prompt set we can use for quality checks.
- Get the redwood trial environment and sample creds set up for your team.

Available times for kickoff next week (PST):
- Tue, Feb 24: 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00
- Wed, Feb 25: 11:00-12:00 or 16:00-17:00

If none of those work, tell me a couple of slots that do and we'll align. I've cc'd Marissa to join the technical discussion. I will follow up with a proposed trial plan and agenda.

Cheers,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

-----

Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposal: evaluation kickoff

Thanks Connor - great call.

We can do Tue, Feb 24 at 14:00 PST. That slot works for Tom and me.

A couple of asks before the kickoff:
- Can you send the trial plan (duration, what you need from us, sample success criteria)?
- We'll want to include our infra lead on the invite if there are credentials/smoke-test steps - I'll add Tom now.
- I'll also share a small sample prompt set (2-3 examples) so you can start a preliminary quality pass.

Appreciate it - looking forward to the next meeting.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of AI Integrations | Finlytics
aisha.khan@finlytics.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Tom Becker <t.becker@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposal: evaluation kickoff

Perfect - Tue 24 @ 14:00 PST locked. I sent a calendar hold (link below).

Attached is a short trial plan (PDF) and a one-page checklist for the kickoff. High-level:
- Trial length: 4 weeks (configurable)
- Goals / success criteria: P95 generation latency < 300ms for the summarization flow at baseline traffic, reranking precision lift of >= 12% on your eval set, and end-to-end cost estimate for a 100k monthly token volume.
- What we need from you: prompt set (you already started this), representative traffic shape, and a technical contact for creds / VPC/network questions.
- SE will run a smoke test during the kickoff and show initial evals using your prompts.

Marissa - can you lead the technical portion and cover: environment setup, smoke test plan, metrics we'll collect, and basic tuning guidance?

I'll attach the trial plan and checklist here.

Connor

-----
Attachments: finlytics-trial-plan.pdf; redwood-eval-ask.xlsx
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finlytics-eval-kickoff-20260224

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@finlytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposal: evaluation kickoff

Hi Aisha / Tom -

Thanks for adding Tom. I'll own the technical kickoff. Proposed 60-min agenda for Tue 24 @ 14:00 PST:
1) 10m - Introductions & success criteria alignment
2) 20m - Environment & credentials (what we'll provision, smoke-test steps)
3) 20m - Run quick live demo with 3 sample prompts (your prompt set) and show initial metrics
4) 10m - Next steps & timeline (trial run, eval reports, checkpoints)

For the smoke test I'll ask you to provide a short example dataset and confirm a test user we can hit with a small load (~100 concurrent requests across a minute) so we can observe latency.

I'll bring: test script, initial eval dashboard, and a checklist to capture any infra blockers. If you prefer a different agenda, let me know and I'll adjust.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Two quick notes:
- We'll share a small representative traffic dump before Monday to help you size the smoke test.
- One success metric to add: false positive rate on the reranker should not increase by more than 3% during the trial.
